strings.d1.s0.name: Hollywood Walk of Fame
strings.d1.s0.tips: See the handprints at TCL Chinese Theatre and the stars on the pavement. Crowds are thin in the morning.
strings.d1.s1.name: Hollywood Sign Seyir Noktası Lake Hollywood Park
strings.d1.s1.tips: The closest free viewpoint to the sign. Bring your camera.
strings.d1.s2.name: Grand Central Market
strings.d1.s2.tips: A market open since 1917. Try Eggslut, Tacos Tumbras a Tomas and Sarita's pupusas.
strings.d1.s3.name: The Broad
strings.d1.s3.tips: A free contemporary art museum. Book online for the Infinity Mirror room.
strings.d1.s4.name: Griffith Observatory
strings.d1.s4.tips: A free observatory with sunset and city lights. The car park fills up, so take the DASH bus.
strings.d1.b0.name: Musso & Frank Grill
strings.d1.b0.tips: Hollywood's restaurant since 1919. Have a martini.
strings.d1.b1.name: Walt Disney Concert Hall
strings.d1.b1.tips: Gehry's silver building. The garden tour is free.
strings.d2.s0.name: Santa Monica Pier
strings.d2.s0.tips: The end of Route 66. Ride the Pacific Park Ferris wheel (~15 USD).
strings.d2.s1.name: Santa Monica Beach
strings.d2.s1.tips: A wide stretch of sand. Hire a bike and follow the coastal path to Venice.
strings.d2.s2.name: Venice Beach Boardwalk
strings.d2.s2.tips: Muscle Beach, street performers and the skate park.
strings.d2.s3.name: Gjusta Venice
strings.d2.s3.tips: Venice's cult bakery-cafe. Order the smoked fish and bread.
strings.d2.s4.name: Venice Canals
strings.d2.s4.tips: Canals and bridges from 1905. A calm walk.
strings.d2.b0.name: Abbot Kinney Boulevard
strings.d2.b0.tips: Boutiques and coffee. An alternative to the canals.
strings.d2.b1.name: The Butcher's Daughter Venice
strings.d3.s0.name: Getty Center
strings.d3.s0.tips: A free museum (parking 20 USD, booking required). See Van Gogh's Irises, the gardens and the city views. Take the tram up.
strings.d3.s1.name: Getty Center Garden Terrace Cafe
strings.d3.s1.tips: The museum cafe, with garden views.
strings.d3.s2.name: Rodeo Drive
strings.d3.s2.tips: Beverly Hills' luxury street. Go window shopping.
strings.d3.s3.name: Beverly Gardens Park
strings.d3.s3.tips: The Beverly Hills sign and a cactus garden.
strings.d3.s4.name: In-N-Out Burger Sunset
strings.d3.s4.tips: A California classic. Order a Double-Double animal style from the secret menu.
strings.d3.b0.name: Nate 'n Al's Beverly Hills
strings.d3.b0.tips: A deli since 1945. Try the pastrami.
strings.d3.b1.name: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
strings.d3.b1.tips: The Urban Light street lamps. An alternative to the Getty.
strings.d4.s0.name: Bradbury Building
strings.d4.s0.tips: The iron atrium from Blade Runner. The lobby is free.
strings.d4.s1.name: Angels Flight Railway
strings.d4.s1.tips: The world's shortest railway, on Bunker Hill.
strings.d4.s2.name: Little Tokyo
strings.d4.s2.tips: A Japanese village plaza and the Japanese American National Museum.
strings.d4.s3.name: Sushi Gen Little Tokyo
strings.d4.s3.tips: A sashimi lunch set. The queue forms at 11:15.
strings.d4.s4.name: Koreatown BBQ Kang Ho-dong Baekjeong
strings.d4.s4.tips: Korean BBQ in Koreatown. Some branches are open 24 hours.
strings.d4.b0.name: Arts District
strings.d4.b0.tips: Murals and breweries, next to Little Tokyo.
strings.d4.b1.name: Langer's Delicatessen
strings.d4.b1.tips: Pastrami since 1947. Order sandwich #19. Next to MacArthur Park.
strings.d5.s0.name: Malibu Pier
strings.d5.s0.tips: 45 minutes along the PCH. Walk the pier and have breakfast at Malibu Farm.
strings.d5.s1.name: El Matador State Beach
strings.d5.s1.tips: A rocky cove with sea caves, LA's most photogenic beach. Take the steps down.
strings.d5.s2.name: Malibu Seafood
strings.d5.s2.tips: A roadside fish counter. Order fish and chips and sit at tables with PCH views.
strings.d5.s3.name: Point Dume
strings.d5.s3.tips: A walk along the headland. Look for whales (December to April) and seals.
strings.d5.s4.name: Getty Villa
strings.d5.s4.tips: Ancient art in a replica Roman villa. Free, booking required, closed on Tuesdays.
strings.d5.b0.name: Neptune's Net
strings.d5.b0.tips: A biker classic for seafood, on the PCH.
strings.d5.b1.name: Zuma Beach
strings.d5.b1.tips: A wide beach. An alternative to El Matador.
strings.d6.s0.name: Universal Studios Hollywood
strings.d6.s0.tips: The Studio Tour (Jaws, Psycho) and Super Nintendo World. 1-Day tickets are ~109 USD online. Buy Express when it's busy.
strings.d6.s1.name: Universal CityWalk
strings.d6.s1.tips: Restaurants outside the park exit, plus Voodoo Doughnut.
strings.d6.s2.name: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Seyir
strings.d6.s2.tips: The Burbank studio gate. The tour the next day is separate (~70 USD).
strings.d6.b0.name: Warner Bros. Studio Tour
strings.d6.b0.tips: A tour of a real working studio. Calmer than Universal.
strings.d6.b1.name: Pink's Hot Dogs
strings.d6.b1.tips: A hot dog stand since 1939, on La Brea.
strings.d7.s0.name: Silver Lake Reservoir Yürüyüşü
strings.d7.s0.tips: A 3.5 km loop around the reservoir, with plenty of neighbourhood dogs.
strings.d7.s1.name: Micheltorena Stairs
strings.d7.s1.tips: The heart-decorated stairs. A classic Silver Lake photo.
strings.d7.s2.name: Intelligentsia Coffee Silver Lake
strings.d7.s2.tips: LA's third-wave coffee, with a courtyard.
strings.d7.s3.name: Guisados Echo Park
strings.d7.s3.tips: Braised-meat tacos. Order the sampler plate for a farewell meal.
strings.d7.s4.name: LAX FlyAway Union Station
strings.d7.s4.tips: The bus from Union Station to LAX takes 45 minutes. Time to say goodbye.
strings.d7.b0.name: Pine & Crane Silver Lake
strings.d7.b0.tips: Taiwanese cuisine. An alternative to tacos.
strings.d7.b1.name: Echo Park Lake
strings.d7.b1.tips: A lotus pond and pedal boats. An alternative to the reservoir.
strings.note0: LA is a car city: hire a car (parking 20-40 USD). The Metro B Line is useful between Hollywood and Downtown. An Uber between the coast and the city costs 20-40 USD.
strings.note1: Winter is 18-20°C and sunny, with a few rainy weeks in January and February. It's whale season in Malibu, the beaches are quiet and it's Oscar season.
strings.note2: The Getty and the Broad are free (booking required), as is Griffith. Universal costs 109+ USD.
strings.note3: Tacos cost 3-5 USD (Guisados, Leo's), In-N-Out 10 USD, and a restaurant meal 30-50 USD. Tip 18-20%. Tax is 9.5% and isn't included in the listed price.
strings.note4: Take the DASH bus up to Griffith (the car park fills up) and arrive 1 hour before sunset.
strings.note5: The sea is cold (18-20°C) with waves and currents, so watch for the lifeguard flags.
